name: Emptiness
clause: When ~ enters, if {W}{W} was spent to cast it, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

needs.proposedSignature: Condition: { kind: 'mana-spent', mana: ManaSymbol[] }  // every listed symbol was spent to cast the source
needs.semantics: The engine already tracks colours spent (`Amount.count: 'colors-spent'` exists), so the payment record is there; what is missing is a condition that asks whether a specific run of symbols was among them, for the hybrid Incarnation cycle's two ETB triggers.
needs.clause: When ~ enters, if {W}{W} was spent to cast it, … / if {B}{B} was spent to cast it, …
